title: Add a named database project
description: Create or adopt an adapter-specific database project and matching Playstack target.

adapter.description: Database schema and persistence adapter to scaffold.

directory.description: Workspace-relative project root; defaults to libs/<adapter>/<name>.

schema.description: Existing workspace-relative Prisma schema file to adopt without moving it.

relocate.description: Move an existing Prisma schema directory into the selected context project after a conflict-free dry run.

clientOutput.description: Optional project-relative generated client output, such as src/generated, during relocation or fresh buildable Prisma generation.

buildable.description: Create a fresh Prisma 7 client library with ESM exports and a generate-then-compile build. Existing schemas and libraries are never converted.
